title: BHOPAL TODAY
en: The gas went away, but the poison is still here.
The abandoned Union Carbide plant. Hundreds of tonnes of toxic waste lay here for years.
From the chemical ponds, the poison kept seeping into the ground.
In the settlements nearby, even the hand-pump water was contaminated.
Many children of survivors were born with illnesses.
A new generation grew up playing near the same ground.
In January 2025, 337 tonnes of waste were finally taken away.
Every 3 December, Bhopal still remembers with candles.
